Pre-market update:
1. Crude Oil find the resistance and right above 100. If you have desire to short, the best product to do so is XLE, BWET.
2. Overnight rotation again between software and semis. That is the nature of chop market. 
3. We are coming into the delicate spot in SPX/QQQ/IWM. Tomorrow FOMC will decide. 
4. My bias is everything is fine. 10y topping and we are relieved the world is not ending. Does that mean upside relief?

Here is the current institutional positioning for educational purpose.
Big participants 1. sold upside calls. not paying for a rally 2. bought ATM puts -- if there is any surprise, these will pay 3. bought cheap crash OTM puts. Insurance for disaster black-swan events. So they are holding the positions through the event, hedged but not exiting. 

So if everything is fine on FOMC, we should see limited upside, and a little volatility. That is still a day trader market. A bounce cannot be trusted. A spike down, not trusted either. Patience is needed for swing traders even tho I know it is really easy to get FOMO and I felt it too from the software rally yesterday. 

Good luck today!
